subject: Regression weight is in the opposite direction from mediators to outcome

messages.author: bdf1100457a62f70
messages.subject: Regression weight is in the opposite direction from mediators to outcome
parts:
Hello!

I am computing a large model with latent mediation analysis and I cannot understand why the direction of the relationship is the opposite of what I expected for the mediation analysis.

Most of the results in the file attached were expected. The SD and Abuse latent variables have correct relationship direction with the mediators (e.g. SD is negatively related with SCS and SD is positively related with nself). The SD and Abuse latent variables were related to the outcome variable (sch) in the expected direction.

However, the relationship direction between the mediators (SCS, nself, pself, nothers, pothers) to the outcome variable (sch) is exactly in the opposite direction for all of them. For example, a simple bivariate correlation between the sum score of SCS and sch would show that they are negatively related, but the lavaan results show the opposite; they are positively related. Likewise, nself is negatively related to sch in lavaan results, but positively related with bivariate correlation.

Would anyone know why this happen?

Thanks!
Edo
